content.title: 'The Pitt' new episode release time, schedule, how to watch
content.text: TVWhat time does new episode of 'The Pitt' come out? How to watch Lucas FrauNorthJersey.comMarch 26, 2026, 3:00 p.m. ETKeep WatchingIf you are hooked on the hit television show “The Pitt” get ready for a new episode on the horizon.Season 2 of the HBO show is more than halfway done. The award-winning series has a new episode coming out on March 5. Here is everything you need to know about the latest release.What time do 'The Pitt' episodes come out?Episode 12 of the “The Pitt” comes out on Thursday, March 26 at 9 p.m. eastern time. New episodes air at the same time every Thursday.Where can I watch 'The Pitt'Season 1 and 2 of “The Pitt” are available for streaming on the platform HBO Max. A subscription is necessary to stream the show.Need a news break? Check out the all new PLAY hub with puzzles, games and more!The basic plan with ads costs $10.99/month or $109.99/year. Other subscription plans are available.How many episodes of 'The Pitt' are in season 2?“The Pitt” Season 2 will have 15 episodes. The finale of Season 2 is set to come out on April 16, 2026.What is 'The Pitt' about?“The Pitt” takes place in a fictional hospital in Pittsburgh. The unique series showcases the life of a nurses working a 15-hour shift.
